text:
emily_pm: Quick sync — seller milepost pricing + escape handoff for private offers. Need a one-pager + launch cadence by EOD Wed. Context: HW partners want an escape if usage < threshold in 90d; SIs want predictable credits during POCs. Can we agree on standard guardrails?
omar_partner: We should standardize. Proposal: 3 commit bands (pilot, growth, enterprise) with explicit milestones and a single escape window at day 90. Escapes return pro-rated credits to partner, not cash.
jess_sales: Agreed on credits. Field asks for an "initiate escape" flow in the seller console and an ops runbook. Also limit escapes to 1 per account per 12 months to reduce abuse.
neil_gpm: Draft bands (numbers illustrative):
```
Pilot: $8k-$15k commit -> 15% off; 30d POC; escape if usage <40% of commit in 90d
Growth: $75k-$150k commit -> 20% off; staged ramp; escape if usage <30% in 90d
Enterprise: $500k+ -> custom pricing; no automatic escape; manual partner ops review
```
emily_pm: Two questions: 1) usage metric (tokens vs dollars vs seats)? 2) who approves escapes — PS, partnerships, or legal?
omar_partner: Use invoiced spend against committed SKU (dollars) for calculation. Auto-approve escapes if account has no prior marketplace-credit history; otherwise route to partnership ops.
jess_sales: For SI POCs where partner-billing hides usage, mark those ineligible for auto-escape and require partner attestation + manual review. Add this to seller FAQ.
neil_gpm: I'll draft a short seller playbook + FAQ: 1-line pitch, sample outreach email, seller checklist for escape cases, and an ops escalation matrix.
emily_pm: Action items: - neil_gpm: price bands + FAQ draft (ETA Tue COB) - omar_partner: legal-friendly escape language for credit returns (ETA Tue COB) - jess_sales: list top 8 sellers to brief and collect feedback (ETA Wed AM) - emily_pm: consolidate into one-pager + joint announce cadence (ETA Wed EOD)
deploybot: created ticket PR-4981 for marketplace-escape-calculation (https://go/redwood/PR-4981).
omar_partner: Note: partners want a 90d "reporting window" clause to mandate partner-supplied usage logs for partner-billed POCs; otherwise, treat as manual review.
jess_sales: Also request a seller-level "grace" workflow: if seller can show active engagement and pipeline, they can request a one-time grace review to convert to a smaller commit rather than escape.
neil_gpm: Renewal idea: auto-offer a conversion window for accounts that hit >=80% of commit within 270d to simplify upsell (email + one-click conversion).
emily_pm: Good. I'll assemble the one-pager and post back here. Ping me if you want to pair on wording. :thumbsup:
